evidence.quote: Sub: Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship 2026-27 Renewal & Verification Notice

issuer.value: State Higher Education Directorate, Scholarship Cell

evidence.quote: ISSUED BY: State Higher Education Directorate, Scholarship Cell

summary_plain.value: All eligible postgraduate scholars must submit renewal dossiers and verify academic credentials online by November 15, 2026 to ensure continuation of monthly stipends.

evidence.quote: All eligible scholars are hereby instructed to submit semester renewal dossiers online on or before 15-11-2026 to avoid disbursement suspension.
Target Beneficiaries: All registered awardees under PG Merit Scheme 2025-27
last date for online upload on the state scholarship portal is 15-11-2026 up to 5:00 PM IST

deadlines.label: Institutional Verification Window
deadlines.original_text: within 7 working days from portal closing

evidence.quote: Principals must countersign uploaded forms within 7 working days from portal closing
Self-attested copy of Semester II Official Marksheet is mandatory
Institution head signed certificate certifying minimum 75% attendance
Hostel residents may attach fee receipt for consideration of additional accommodation stipend (optional)

action_steps.text: Obtain signed attendance certificate certifying minimum 75% attendance from your Head of Department.

evidence.quote: Step 1: Obtain signed attendance certificate from Head of Department.

action_steps.text: Log in to official portal at https://scholarships.state.gov.in and choose Renewal 2026.

evidence.quote: Step 2: Log in to portal https://scholarships.state.gov.in and click Renewal 2026.

action_steps.text: Upload scanned PDF copies of Semester II marksheets and the attendance certificate.

evidence.quote: Step 3: Upload PDF copies of Semester II marksheet and attendance certificate.

action_steps.text: Print final submission acknowledgment slip and submit copy to College Nodal Officer.

evidence.quote: Step 4: Submit physical printout of submitted acknowledgment to College Nodal Officer.

submission_channel.value: https://scholarships.state.gov.in with physical acknowledgment copy to College Nodal Officer

evidence.quote: Submissions will be accepted exclusively via state portal https://scholarships.state.gov.in

fees_penalties.description: Forfeiture of monthly scholarship stipend for subsequent quarters

evidence.quote: Failure to submit by stipulated date shall result in forfeiture of scholarship for subsequent quarters.

warnings.message: College verification deadline depends on institution working days ('within 7 working days from portal closing'). Check directly with your college nodal officer.

evidence.quote: within 7 working days from portal closing
